name: Constructions-3D MiniPrinter XL
summary: Compact gantry 3D concrete printer for the factory: prints precast parts such as columns, partitions and openings on two pallets in turn, up to about 1 t of mortar per hour.

germany.statusNote: EU maker (France) publishes a euro starting price and an online configurator; order by quote through the configurator or contact form. No German reseller found.

sellers.name: Constructions-3D
sellers.note: 83 rue des Mines Innovantes, 59860 Bruay-sur-l'Escaut, France; configurator on the product page.

specs.label: Exterior L × W × H
specs.quote: Exterior (L x W x H)3.45x1.85x2.18 m

specs.label: Output
specs.conditions: up to 1 t of material per hour for several hours; 5–7 t in a 7-hour day (MiniPrinter machines)
specs.quote: The MiniPrinter machines are capable of printing up to 1 ton of material per hour for several hours.

specs.label: Largest grain
specs.quote: with a maximum particle size of 6mm in DN50 hose size config. (via the additional DN50 kit), or 4mm in DN35 hose size config.

specs.label: Print bed
specs.value: 2 standard pallets or 1 large custom pallet
specs.conditions: multi-pallet mode prints on one while the other sets
specs.quote: The MiniPrinter XL accommodates either 2 standard pallets or 1 custom large pallet

specs.label: Software subscription
specs.quote: There is no subscription associated with the MiniPrinter XL.

notes: Stationary gantry printer for indoor, off-site production; parts are lifted out and installed on site.
Sold with a wet-mix pump (needs an external mixer) or a dry-mix pump that can be fed from a silo.
Twice the print volume of the MiniPrinter EDU; other specifications are the same (maker FAQ).
